## Combo 250-779-1479-3534-5412
Cards: The Gitrog Monster + Kodama of the East Tree + Dakmor Salvage + Field of the Dead + Coastal Hornclaw
Color identity: BGU | Bracket: Powerful | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite landfall triggers; Near-infinite creature tokens; Near-infinite card draw; Near-infinite draw triggers; Infinite self-mill; Near-infinite self-discard triggers
Start: The Gitrog Monster (battlefield); Kodama of the East Tree (battlefield); Dakmor Salvage (hand); Field of the Dead (battlefield); Coastal Hornclaw (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
  You control seven or more lands with different names.
Steps: Play Dakmor Salvage.
  When Dakmor Salvage enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
  Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
  Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
  The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
  If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
  Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
  Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
  When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
  When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
  Repeat from step 4.

Color identity: BGU | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite storm count
Requires: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana (battlefield, graveyard)
Start: Havengul Lich (battlefield); Grimgrin, Corpse-Born (battlefield); Pawn of Ulamog (battlefield); Enduring Vitality (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
Steps: Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
  Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
  When that creature dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
  If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
  If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
  Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
  Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
  Repeat.
